name: Roboto Mono and Figtree
summary: A monospace face for headings and code over a geometric sans for body text, for technical decks.
description: Roboto Mono and Figtree is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Roboto Mono for headings and code with Figtree for body text. The monospace headings give engineering and product decks a technical voice and match the code blocks, while Figtree keeps lists, tables and chart labels proportional and easy to read.
